findings.reason: the §4 design must either specify that the count enumerates `<name>-cache` keys across each `runtime-*` subdirectory (extending `cache_reuse_summary.served_keys` to do so) or name the layout and drop the claim that the existing owner already answers it.
findings.text: `served_keys(digest)` enumerates one directory non-recursively with `os.listdir` and strips only the `-cache` suffix. The guard's served directory (`jax.config.jax_compilation_cache_dir`) is the PARENT of several `runtime-<hash>` subdirectories; measured on the pin at `/work/projects/imas_gpu/sophelio/jax-cache/nova-prewarm/nova/jax-compilation`, that parent holds 4 `runtime-*` directories, each holding a `python`-key set of paired `<name>-cache`/`<name>-atime` files (315 top-level files in `runtime-0745ecebea4cb264e054`) beside an `xla_gpu_per_fusion_autotune_cache_dir` subtree (17,761 files). Reusing `served_keys` verbatim would therefore (a) return the 4 `runtime-*` directory NAMES if handed the parent, not the program keys; (b) count every `<name>-atime` companion as a distinct key (its suffix is not `-cache`); and (c) admit the autotune directory's own name — so it reproduces neither the program-key count nor the autotune exclusion §4's "Done when" demands ("served_entries equals the count of program-key entries on disk").

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §3's landed machinery is one traced body (`operator_request_body`, `nova/equilibrium/fixed_point.py:972` and the serving scan at `:1026`) behind a compact `lax.switch`-on-`request.kind` interface, and §4's change extends the guard's own `served_directory_state` rather than adding a module.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the §4 owner note routes `served_entries` through `scripts/h200_test_lane/cache_reuse_summary.py::served_keys`, but that function does not compute the “program-key entries on disk” §4 requires, so the plan's claimed reuse is not actually available from the owner it names.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts this week `public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0`; §4 adds a receipt field (`served_entries`) and an internal pytest-plugin count, no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family, so there is no surface to retire or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched: §1 lands into `nova/equilibrium/{fixed_point,forward,forward_operator,reduced_newton}.py`, §3's request machine into `fixed_point.py::operator_request_body`/`run_operator_requests`, §2 onto the existing gate `benchmarks/solve_program_size_gate.py`, and §4's owner notes (2026-10-06 comments) name `cache_reuse_summary.py`, `prewarm_row.py`, `publish_prewarm_pool.py`… (the pin/row machinery) — no subsystem is added without naming what it extends.
